All five outcome variants are implemented and tested. Here's a summary of what was built:

**`src/newsletter.ts`** — `unsubscribe(email, topic)` returns `UnsubscribeResult`:

| Kind | Trigger |
|---|---|
| `email_error` | email fails `\S+@\S+` regex |
| `topic_error` | topic not in `KNOWN_TOPICS` |
| `not_subscribed` | API returns `{"error":"not_subscribed"}` |
| `connection_error` | `fetch` throws (network failure) |
| `unsubscribed` | API returns any other success body |

**`src/newsletter.test.ts`** — 5 new tests in a `describe("unsubscribe")` block, using the same MSW `startApiServer` helper and `server.use()` per-test override pattern as the existing `subscribe` suite.
